items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024
items.q: we’re starting with Mike Rodriguez and Marshall Gilkes. They — we send them the rhythm tracks which Cole sort of organized, and then we’re transcribing all their solos

ctx.x: What’s on your plate at the moment that you’re working on?

I’m actually working on a new series of — what do I want to call them — it’s twelve standards, two choruses on each standard, and my son and I, Cole and I, are producing it together. We’re getting some of our favorite brass players so we’re starting with Mike Rodriguez and Marshall Gilkes. They — we send them the rhythm tracks which Cole sort of organized, and then we’re transcribing all their solos and putting it out as a transcription book, also you’ll get the play-along tracks that you can play yourself along…
